name: kit.logo
description: The brand's logo: an uploaded file's address, never a blob: URL, which dies on reload.
sql: update brandbase.brand_kits k set logo = jsonb_build_object('src', :src::text, 'name', :name::text), version = k.version + 1, updated_at = now() where k.brand_id = :brand returning brandbase.camel(to_jsonb(k)) || jsonb_build_object('updatedAt', brandbase.iso(k.updated_at)) as result
